svg.title: Cheap over everything, expensive over fifty
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “Cheap over everything, expensive over fifty” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A hand-drawn funnel: 47,300 chunks enter a wide mouth, pass through stage one hybrid retrieval at 8.9 milliseconds to a neck of 50 candidates, then through a stage two cross-encoder at 96 milliseconds to a spout of ten. Above, a bi-encoder sketch is labelled precomputed and free while a cross-encoder sketch must run per pair, and the margin arithmetic 47,300 pairs over 520 per second is circled as 91 SECONDS. Two ten-item result lists show the gold chunk moving from position seven to position one, and paired bars of NDCG and p95 latency by rerank depth 10 to 200 show quality flattening at 0.85 while latency climbs past a dashed 210 millisecond SLO line, with N=50 ringed as the knee.
svg.text: Cheap over everything, expensive over fifty
draw it from memory, then compare
